text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pengangkutan Jalan

(Larangan Penggunaan Jalan) (Jalan Persekutuan) 2023.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Mac 2023.

Larangan

2. Pemanduan kenderaan di atas bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1)

Jadual Pertama sebagaimana yang ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual Kedua,

melainkan di atas jalan arah yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2) Jadual Pertama,

bagi tempoh yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (3) Jadual Pertama, dilarang.

JADUAL PERTAMA

(1)

Jalan yang baginya

Larangan Terpakai

 (2)

(3)

Sebahagian Laluan 101,

Jalan Pintas Gebeng bermula

dari seksyen 5.35 hingga

seksyen 5.60 sebagaimana

yang ditunjukkan dalam peta

dalam Jadual Kedua

Kenderaan dari Kuantan

ke Kemaman dan sebaliknya

hendaklah menggunakan jalan

lencongan sementara

sebagaimana yang ditunjukkan

dalam peta dalam Jadual Kedua

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Menteri Kerja Raya

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRANSPORT (PROHIBITION OF USE OF ROAD)

(FEDERAL ROADS) ORDER 2023

WHEREAS by P.U. (B) 40/2023 published on 7 February 2023, notice was given of the

intention to make an order under section 70 of the Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333]:

AND WHEREAS no objection was received by the Minister of Works against

the making of such order:

NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 70 of the Act,

the Minister of Works, after taking into consideration the matters referred to in

subsection 70(2) of the Act, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Road Transport

(Prohibition of Use of Road) (Federal Roads) Order 2023.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 March 2023.

Prohibition

2. The driving of vehicles on the part of the road as specified in column (1)

of the First Schedule as shown on the map in the Second Schedule, otherwise than

on the routes specified in column (2) of the First Schedule, for the period specified

in column (3) of the First Schedule, is prohibited.

FIRST SCHEDULE

(1)

(2)
